### Findings
1. **P0 — C12 acceptance/merge gate: Trivy intended vulnerability rejection is missing.** tools/ci/check-security.py:169–240 invokes only an expected-clean Trivy scan, then validates package-bearing target recognition. .github/workflows/security.yml:54–72 newly depends on this enforcement. docs/planning/evidence/c12-ready-trivy.json:564–580 and c12-final-current-trivy.json:2–13 provide clean observations only. The supervisor explicitly confirmed no known-vulnerability intended rejection exists anywhere in the frozen packet; earlier production-only scans and C5 advisory repair are not this oracle. Q6 and the changed-enforcement contract require both clean acceptance and intended-specific rejection, not just recognized packages or arbitrary failure.
   **Smallest fix/check:** add a passive known-vulnerable lock-graph control using the selected Trivy CLI and same scanner/dev-dependency/severity/exit/DB scope. Observe status1 plus the expected advisory/package/severity in its actual report, unchanged declared inputs, and a corresponding fixed/restored clean0 control. Do not install or execute a vulnerable application. Run on authorized ClaudeOS, retain this missing-evidence disposition, bind results to repaired source, refreeze and re-review.

2. **P0 — C12 acceptance/merge gate: Semgrep --work bypasses the publication-directory rule boundary.** tools/ci/check-security.py:71–72 resolves and creates any new caller-selected work directory without excluding ROOT. After the root scan succeeds, :144–149 writes the probe and copies all three private policy bodies into work/config.name. rule_configs():43–53 constrains the source policy directory/file symlinks only; install-tools.py:79–81 constrains the installation prefix only. Thus a new --work inside the checkout places licensed policy bodies into the publication tree despite the stated boundary in docs/ci-checks.md and c12-licensing-disposition.md. Configured RUNNER_TEMP/native outside-checkout runs avoided this path but do not enforce CLI behavior. The supervisor confirmed this is not an established caller-only precondition. This is a source-traced contract contradiction, not an assertion that actual redistribution occurred or a legal conclusion.
   **Smallest fix/check:** for Semgrep mode, reject a resolved work directory within ROOT before mkdir or any scan/probe/policy write. Document that narrow requirement. Exercise direct and symlink-resolved inside-checkout paths with named rejection and no created destination/body, plus an outside-checkout positive scan/control. Preserve existing source-prefix/file-symlink controls; no universal directory policy or race-proof sandbox claim is required. Recheck affected SAST/source wiring on authorized ClaudeOS and refreeze.
